body: Lil Yachty made his WWE in-ring debut in his hometown of Atlanta during Sunday Night’s Main Event, surviving five minutes against United States Champion Baron Corbin. The challenge earned Trick Williams an immediate title rematch. Tyler, The Creator @feliciathegoat was also in attendance, while Quavo performed during the event.
